title: The horseshoe defect correction preserves both row squares and the augmentation
statement:
theorem corrected_middle_map
    {C : Type u} [Category.{v} C] [Abelian C]
    {X Y Z X' Y' Z' : CochainComplex C ℕ} {U U' : C}
    (α : X ⟶ Y) (β : Y ⟶ Z) (α' : X' ⟶ Y') (β' : Y' ⟶ Z')
    (φA : X ⟶ X') (φC : Z ⟶ Z') (χ q : Y ⟶ Y')
    (ε : (CochainComplex.single₀ C).obj U ⟶ Y)
    (ε' : (CochainComplex.single₀ C).obj U' ⟶ Y')
    (b : (CochainComplex.single₀ C).obj U ⟶ (CochainComplex.single₀ C).obj U')
    (hχα : α ≫ χ = φA ≫ α') (hχβ : χ ≫ β' = β ≫ φC)
    (hqa : α ≫ q = 0) (hqb : q ≫ β' = 0)
    (hε : ε ≫ χ - ε ≫ q = b ≫ ε') :
    ∃ φB : Y ⟶ Y', ε ≫ φB = b ≫ ε' ∧
      α ≫ φB = φA ≫ α' ∧ φB ≫ β' = β ≫ φC := by
  refine ⟨χ - q, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · simpa only [Preadditive.comp_sub] using hε
  · rw [Preadditive.comp_sub, hχα, hqa, sub_zero]
  · rw [Preadditive.sub_comp, hχβ, hqb, sub_zero]

source.place: Tag 015I, final correction of the middle map

proof.text: Since C is abelian it is preadditive. For cochain complexes, morphisms are families fⁿ satisfying fⁿ ≫ d_targetⁿ = d_sourceⁿ ≫ fⁿ⁺¹. Define φBⁿ = χⁿ − qⁿ. For every n ≥ 0, (χⁿ − qⁿ) ≫ d_Y′ⁿ = χⁿ ≫ d_Y′ⁿ − qⁿ ≫ d_Y′ⁿ = d_Yⁿ ≫ χⁿ⁺¹ − d_Yⁿ ≫ qⁿ⁺¹ = d_Yⁿ ≫ (χⁿ⁺¹ − qⁿ⁺¹), by bilinearity and the chain-map equations for χ and q. Thus φB = χ − q is a morphism of complexes. Addition, subtraction and composition of these maps are componentwise; the chain-map equations are closed under addition and negation by the same bilinear identities. No exactness or injectivity is required.

source.place: Tag 00ZY, definition-preadditive; elementary subtraction calculation in the category of cochain complexes

proof.text: By bilinearity, ε ≫ φB = ε ≫ (χ − q) = ε ≫ χ − ε ≫ q = b ≫ ε′, where the last equality is precisely hε. This verifies the augmentation square as an equality of maps of complexes, including degree zero.

source.place: Tag 00ZY, definition-preadditive; elementary subtraction calculation in the category of cochain complexes

proof.text: By bilinearity and hχα and hqa, α ≫ φB = α ≫ χ − α ≫ q = φA ≫ α′ − 0 = φA ≫ α′. This verifies the left row square.

source.place: Tag 00ZY, definition-preadditive; elementary subtraction calculation in the category of cochain complexes

proof.text: By bilinearity and hχβ and hqb, φB ≫ β′ = χ ≫ β′ − q ≫ β′ = β ≫ φC − 0 = β ≫ φC. Together with the preceding two identities this supplies the required witness and all three clauses.
